head.heading: Much more than a real estate agency

items.text: Introducing HousySpace
At HousySpace we believe every property decision deserves time, judgement and personal attention. We go with you to find the best way to take the next step.
Our story
A very simple idea: people, at the centre.

HousySpace was born five years ago. Those of us behind it had already been working in the sector for some time and knew what could be done differently: with more closeness, truly personal attention, and treating each client's concerns as our own.
That is why we did not want to be just another estate agency, but a project true to how we understand this profession.
We still get the same satisfaction from sharing the joy of someone finding their first home, helping a family start a new chapter or accompanying a client in making the right decision.
Behind every property there is a story, an important decision and people who trust us.

items.title: Today
items.text: we keep growing with those who choose us again and recommend us
Our philosophy
Every property is different. So is every person.

We do not believe every property transaction should be approached in the same way. Before proposing a strategy we listen, study the circumstances of each property and weigh the different possibilities.
Our job is not just to manage a transaction, but to provide judgement so that you can decide whether to take the step, when and how, with knowledge, transparency and security.
That you are happy at every step, not only when you sign.
How we work
Four steps and the same advisor from start to finish.

items.title: We listen
items.text: What you need, what deadlines you have and what state the property is in.

items.title: We study
items.text: We review the documentation and analyse the market.

items.title: We define the strategy
items.text: Tailored to each situation and explained before we start.

items.title: We coordinate
items.text: The same advisor handles the paperwork, keeps you informed and works with the specialised professionals who are needed.
*Always an* extra mile
In a property transaction, situations nobody had foreseen can arise: pending documents, financing difficulties, technical issues or procedures that require other professionals to step in.

We anticipate when we can and, when something unexpected comes up, we get involved in finding a solution and in coordinating those who can help resolve it. For us, going the extra mile means not walking away from a difficulty just because it is not part of the usual brokerage.
That is what we mean by:
Don't worry, I'll take care of it.
Professional collaborations
A trusted team for every need.

For the legal, tax, financial and technical needs of a transaction we work with specialised professionals. We coordinate the consultation and its timing with the transaction; the specialised work is carried out by each professional.
If we recommend someone, it is because we know them well: for years we have surrounded ourselves with professionals who work as well as or better than we do and whom we trust fully.
